skills.name: extract-logs
skills.description: Parse raw gtest / ctest / run_cpu.py / run_st.py logs into a normalized results object (passed/failed/skipped counts + per-case status). Use after a run, or when asked to extract or normalize test logs into structured results.

skills.name: full-analysis-pipeline
skills.description: Orchestrate the full regression flow end to end: run-testcase -> extract-logs -> generate-report -> review-inconsistencies, then hand off to skill-maintainer when corrections or reusable patterns surface. Use when asked to run the full analysis pipeline or a complete regression analysis.

skills.name: generate-report
skills.description: Turn normalized run results into a Markdown summary and a standalone HTML report. Use when asked to generate a report or dashboard from a regression run, or after the pipeline has produced results.

skills.name: pto-isa
skills.description: Run and triage pto-isa regression: CPU simulator ST and NPU simulator ST (A5/A3/A6, incl. the A6 dav_9201 / v200 workflow), plus env/soc handling and known failure patterns. Use when working in the pto-isa repo, running pto-isa tests, or asked for a pto-isa regression run or failure triage.

skills.name: pto-vmi
skills.description: Run and triage pto-vmi regression: DSL ST and CCE ST on the A5 simulator (ptoas-vmi msprof / bisheng + camodel), plus the CCE-vs-VMI CA metrics workflow (EX / IPC / vf_real / dual-issue / stalls). Use when working in the pto-vmi repo, running pto-vmi kernels, or asked for a CCE/DSL regression run or triage.

skills.name: review-inconsistencies
skills.description: Compare a regression run against the pinned baseline (or another run): detect pass->fail regressions, fail->pass fixes, new/removed cases, and perf regressions using avg and p99 (flag p99 +15% even if avg is stable). Use when asked to review a run or compare it to the baseline.

skills.name: run-testcase
skills.description: Run one or more pto-isa benchmark/regression suites (CPU simulator ST and NPU simulator ST) and capture a reproducible run record. Use when asked to run a regression, run the suite matrix, execute a single suite/testcase, or re-run a suite for a target such as pto-isa.

skills.name: skill-maintainer
skills.description: Review regression results and user corrections, then propose or apply minimal, reviewable updates to the skills: capture lessons as LRN entries and promote them (gated + LLM-reviewed) into the shared corpus. Use when asked to update the skills, remember a correction, or review learnings/recent.md and promote reusable patterns.
